scope: Complete construction, inspection and acceptance of one explicitly designed stormwater drainage network: 900 m of selected PVC-U SN8 OD 315 pipe at slope 0.005 and design flow 80 l/s. Pipe-system materials, earthworks, inlets, manholes, silt traps, outlet interface, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are direct project inputs.
sourceAuthority: Approved stormwater design organization, hydrology and geotechnical engineers, pipe-system manufacturer, construction laboratory and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved catchment calculation, plan and longitudinal profile
approved pipe material, stiffness, diameter, slope and design-flow schedule
approved trench, bedding, surround, backfill and excess-soil quantities
approved joints, fittings, inlets, manholes, covers, silt traps and outlet-interface schedule
installation method with labor and mechanism quantities
conditional dewatering, trench-shoring and road-restoration schedules
supplier pipe-segment length and approved retained spare length

rules.totalNeed: installed net length + retained spare length

forbiddenClaims: trench, pipe or restoration quantities derived from generic length coefficients
automatic inlet, manhole, silt-trap or connection-node spacing
automatic dewatering, shoring or road restoration
universal pipe spare or supplier segment length
sanitary sewer, pressure sewer or full receiving-water outlet structure included
